name: Subagent Cost Tracker
description: Logs subagent usage to a cost tracking file for monitoring resource consumption
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Log subagent usage to cost tracking file
LOG_FILE="${HOME}/.claude/subagent-costs.log"
TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
PROJECT=$(basename "$(pwd)")
echo "${TIMESTAMP} | project=${PROJECT} | subagent_completed" >> "$LOG_FILE"
exit 0
